updates.title: Upcoming: nine classic purchased starter eggs
updates.detail: Paid Mystery Eggs are restricted to the nine classic Kanto, Johto and Hoenn starters; custom babies remain available through secret Odd Eggs. RelicDex now includes clickable ability explanations and the correct green normal Valkiri art alongside approved Gemlin art.
updates.status: Website source prepared; egg pool needs a new compiled ROM

updates.title: Upcoming: Four secret nursery eggs
updates.detail: Scarabub, Skarmet, Mootiny and Gemlin become egg-exclusive via four cryptic four-word Route 34 nursery rhymes. The original seven baby eggs remain; each custom egg is separately claimable once per save. The Pokémon summary-screen Move Relearner shortcut is removed, while the NPC remains.
updates.status: Development branch source implementation, NOT yet in public Alpha 3, no ROM QA

updates.title: Alpha 2.5 — Eeveelutions & 22 battle backgrounds
updates.detail: Ten new native 64×64 Eeveelution art sets, 22 battle backgrounds (12 original, 10 CC0) and ROM-matched RelicDex sprites including Noxichu, Charaxis, and other updated custom forms. No additional unapproved SpriteCook sprites.
updates.status: ROM build verified; in-game display and save QA outstanding

updates.title: 444 species
updates.detail: All 444 canonical entries have registered PRU species definitions. This does not yet mean 444 independently tracked Pokédex catches or 444 verified encounter paths.

updates.title: Valkiri #319
updates.detail: Previously Valkyvoir. Green is the normal palette and blue is the shiny palette, reusing approved PRL sprites without recolouring. Gardevoir evolves with an Ancient Stone at level 45.
updates.status: Build verified; in-game palette/evolution QA outstanding

updates.title: Sound moves
updates.detail: Gardevoir gains Round at level 36 and Hyper Voice at 38. Valkiri can relearn both and gains Boomburst on evolution and at level 55.
updates.status: Build verified; in-game learn prompts QA outstanding

updates.title: Throat Spray
updates.detail: Sold at Goldenrod Department Store 2F for ₽10,000; held-item effect integrated.

updates.title: Noxichu #032
updates.detail: Pikachu's Moon Stone alternative evolution learns Bite immediately. Approved newer PRL battle artwork and party icon replace the older PJR sprites.
updates.status: Build verified; newest sprite QA outstanding

updates.title: Evolutions
updates.detail: 54 custom evolution targets checked, including 27 level-45 Ancient Stone routes and simplified Eeveelution methods. Exact outcomes still require saved-playthrough tests.

updates.title: Johto rebalance
updates.detail: 202 trainer parties adjusted. Wild encounters cover 37 Johto areas and 63 day/night variants, including 145 slots using appropriate evolved species.

updates.title: Steevee & Neevee
updates.detail: These are recurring human trainers, not species: Route 37 (replaces Ann & Anne, levels 30–32), Route 47 (38–40), Route 44 (44–47), and Kanto Route 3 (61–64). All four use the approved PRL custom Eevee Twins battle intro.
updates.status: Build verified; actual encounter/intro QA outstanding

updates.title: Johto Gym Leaders
updates.detail: Eight upgraded first-encounter teams with signature Relics. £10,000, a TM and an item per leader; full team roster in the linked Google Sheet.

updates.title: Rocket and game systems
updates.detail: Johto Jessie/James/Meowth positioning and custom intro; Chansey training; 92 named TMs and eight HMs.
updates.status: Build verified; save-file gameplay QA outstanding

updates.title: Future Kanto work
updates.detail: Articuno, Zapdos and Moltres roaming in Kanto and properly evolved wild species on Kanto routes remain planned, not implemented.
